combo.description: To All In activate Q then Flash once in AA range, follow up with E and execute your target with R.
Quickly burst by activating Q then Flash once in AA range and instantly R after your AA.
You can R then instantly Flash during the animation to reposition.
Your most simple trade is to Q instantly after your first AA then E.
When close to an opponent E then Q R instantly after your AA finishes.
To fight normally activate Q to gain movespeed then AA E, once E finishes AA again and execute with R.
Make sure to use Q as an Auto Attack Reset. AA instantly into Q and another AA.
